scope: Ki Blast Ultimate coverage expansion from current Ultimate Attack taxonomy

records.name: Super Ghost Kamikaze Attack
records.effect: Creates five powerful ghost projectiles that launch sequentially; current documentation identifies a 5-hit long-range projectile Ultimate.

records.name: Full Power Energy Blast Volley
records.effect: Fires a tracking cone/barrage of Ki bullets; current documentation records up to 29 hits and knockback.

records.name: Neo Tri-Beam
records.effect: Fires a Tri-Beam and can be repeated, consuming 100 Stamina per additional use.

records.name: Vacation Delete
records.character_source: Raditz; Turles Customize Partner; Omega Shenron Customize Partner; Bardock Customize Partner; Majin Buu (Gohan Absorbed) Customize Partner
records.effect: Throws a Ki ball that explodes for 8 hits and temporarily paralyzes the target for 5 seconds.

records.name: Breaker Energy Wave
records.character_source: Goku; Goku (Super Saiyan God) Customize Partner; Goku (GT); Goku (Super Saiyan 4)
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 101: Seeking Fighters for Tournament
records.effect: One-use low-health beam Ultimate; available to CaCs.

records.name: God of Destruction's Menace
records.character_source: God of Destruction Champa; Android 13; Super Baby 2 Customize Partner
records.effect: Throws multiple tracking Ki balls; additional inputs can extend the sequence to 26 hits.

records.name: Revenge Death Ball
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 127: Multiverse Match of the Century
records.effect: Chargeable tracking Ki sphere; 12 hits at minimum charge and up to 22 at maximum charge while recovering Ki.

records.name: Gigantic Burst
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 127: Multiverse Match of the Century
records.effect: Two-stage Ultimate: three sweeping Ki waves followed by a combined spiraling beam; 25 hits.

records.name: Prominence Flash
records.character_source: Vegeta (Super Saiyan God); Vegeta Customize Partner; Vegeta (Super Saiyan 4) Customize Partner
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 137: Tournament of Power Round 2
records.effect: Long-range Ki wave whose damage increases through successive activations up to the third use; current page records 38 hits.

notes: Removed duplicate Teleporting Vanishing Ball identity already established in batch 309; remaining records are the other Ultimate taxonomy entries.
